messages:
Priya Rao: hey all, small snag on day 1 — Kandji enrollment starts but stalls when the laptop is plugged into the wall ethernet jack at my desk. It shows a captive-portal/login required popup in the browser before network is usable. Enrollment never finishes. If I use hotspot it goes through. macOS Ventura 13.6. Any tips?

IT Desk: welcome Priya! captive portals can definitely block the MDM traffic. Do you see the captive portal page in Safari/Chrome or is it a network-level block?

Priya Rao: yes browser redirects to office-guest.example.com and asks me to accept terms. I didn't expect to see that during OOBE.

Jordan (Device Admin): yep that's the issue. Kandji's initial profile download must reach our endpoints without a captive portal intercept. Two quick fixes: (1) Use wifi or phone hotspot to enroll, then replug ethernet. (2) If you need wired, NetOps can whitelist the device MAC or serial on the onboarding VLAN so it bypasses the captive portal until enrollment completes.

NetOps: we can add a MAC-based bypass for onboarding. Send us the device serial or MAC and we'll add a short-lived exception that expires after 24h.

Priya Rao: serial is C02PRY123456. Is there anything i need to run locally?

Jordan (Device Admin): after we add the exception it'll be automatic. If you want to enroll now via wifi, do that and then run `sudo kandjictl runAction --device "C02PRY123456" --action SyncRecoveryKey` from our console (or we'll trigger it). If you enroll wired later and see the captive portal again, unplug and use wifi.

Kandji-bot: Enrollment attempt recorded for "Priya Rao - MacBookPro14" at 2026-11-10T10:02:47Z.

NetOps: added DHCP whitelisting for MAC/serial C02PRY123456 on onboarding VLAN. Exception will auto-expire in 24h.

Priya Rao: tried again after NetOps change and enrollment completed! saw FileVault prompt and Okta device appeared. thanks everyone :sparkles: 

IT Desk: great — Jordan, can you add a single-line KB: "If you hit a captive portal during wired enrollment, request a MAC whitelist from NetOps or enroll over wifi and then replug."

Jordan (Device Admin): adding KB now. Also opening a small ops ticket to document common captive portal sites in each office.

Priya Rao: sweet, all set. appreciate the help :bow:
